{{Top|leg}}
'''Trosilon''' was a deadly nerve gas that was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] deployed trosilon during an attack on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kostra]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Fulkrehm Protial]] was exposed to the gas during the attack, causing irreparable damage to his motor control skills. He transferred to [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] and used "trosilon" as his identification code.
